scope: Pure runtime selection and file validation; fixtures are not new character artwork.

checks.name: Whole source canvas and its foot anchor are preserved for dedicated views
Three-quarter fallback cannot mirror without an exact-drawing review
An uncertain anatomy flag requires an explicit per-identity bilateral review
Protected asymmetric incarnations never accept a bilateral override
Clip frame boundaries use integer game ticks; no interpolation into adjacent cells
A looping clip wraps at its exact total frame duration
Attack lock remains authoritative even during screen crossing and retreat
Retreat state is relative to facing, not absolute screen direction
Missing action art falls back to a static side pose without claiming animation
Malformed clip frames cannot be selected by the renderer
Visual registry changes neither 346 fighter definitions nor physics
Production coverage distinguishes native reference poses, single side and missing artwork
Raster metadata matches measured committed PNG and WebP dimensions
Empty, truncated or non-raster inputs are refused before registration
Presentation swap moves actors between positions instead of making them face outward
No published mockup image is referenced as a character or stage
